# Cresterix

> Cresterix is a digital product engineering company building intelligent software, scalable platforms and digital experiences for businesses worldwide.

We don't just build software. We engineer digital products that move businesses forward. Based in Trivandrum, Kerala, India, working with clients internationally.

## Pages

- [Software Development Services — Web, Mobile, SaaS, AI](https://www.cresterix.com/solutions): Product engineering, web platforms, mobile apps, SaaS, AI and cloud services. We build production-ready digital products for businesses worldwide.
- [Industries We Serve — FinTech, Healthcare, Retail](https://www.cresterix.com/industries): We build software for FinTech, retail, healthcare, education, logistics, real estate, media and startups — designed around each sector's real workflows.
- [Our Work — Software Development Case Studies](https://www.cresterix.com/work): Case studies from Cresterix: real digital products we engineered end to end, the problems they solved and the technology behind each build.
- [About Cresterix — Product Engineering Team in India](https://www.cresterix.com/about): Cresterix is a digital product engineering team based in Trivandrum, Kerala, India, delivering software for clients worldwide with clarity and craft.
- [Contact Cresterix — Start a Software Project](https://www.cresterix.com/contact): Tell us what you're trying to build, improve or solve. Reach the Cresterix team in Trivandrum, Kerala by phone or email — we reply to every enquiry.

## Articles

- [When Should a Business Build Custom Software?](https://www.cresterix.com/insights/when-to-build-custom-software): Most businesses should buy off-the-shelf software, not build it. Here are the four signals that genuinely justify building, and the four that don't. (Software Architecture, by Godson Morais)
- [Building a Scalable SaaS Architecture](https://www.cresterix.com/insights/scalable-saas-architecture): Scaling a SaaS product is rarely about traffic. It is about tenant isolation, background work and the decisions that get expensive to reverse later. (SaaS, by Godson Morais)
- [How Businesses Can Automate Manual Workflows With AI](https://www.cresterix.com/insights/automate-manual-workflows-with-ai): AI automation works on a narrower set of business tasks than the marketing suggests. Here is where it reliably pays back, and where it quietly fails. (Business Automation, by Godson Morais)
